evidence: The text mentions the use of XPS, LEIS, RBS, XRF, ICP-OES, and TEM for characterization. For example, 'The ZrO2 and Al2O3 islands are all of a similar size... as seen by x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) measurements' and 'The surface fractions were measured by LEIS... The LEIS measurement details are described elsewhere... The calculated and measured surface fractions are compared as a function of the number of ALD reaction cycles... The island growth model provides information also of the amount of oxidized silicon formed... The amount of oxidized silicon is directly proportional to the surface fractions of the islands... The Sisl values calculated for the Al2O3 process are shown in Fig. 8 together with the SiOx thickness measured by XPS... SiOx thicknesses have been measured by XPS also for the ZrO2 process... The island density was estimated from 10−3 to 10−2 nm−2 for the Al2O3 processes... The results of the modeling agree, therefore, semiquantitatively with the results of the TEM measurements.'
